summary: EuroDry Ltd., a NASDAQ-listed Marshall Islands drybulk owner, disclosed via Form 6-K a shipbuilding contract with Hengli Shipbuilding (Dalian) for a third 82,000 DWT Kamsarmax bulk carrier. The eco-design EEDI Phase 3 vessel costs approximately $37.0 million and is scheduled for delivery in Q3 2029, financed with debt and equity. The order is conditional on receipt of a bank refund guarantee acceptable to the Company. It brings the newbuilding program to five vessels totaling 373,000 DWT. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium or shareholder vote is involved; this is an ordinary fleet-renewal capital commitment, not a special situation. Watch financing terms, refund-guarantee execution and delivery timing risk.
